SPLIT-PATH FORK — the LEG SHAPE routes the cube (commit-at-entrance). HOOK leg => HIGH route: a hook-gated STEEP STAIRCASE up, ~50deg to MATCH the standalone steep climb (each up/down staircase run = (length-flatTop)/2 = (11.4-4)/2 = 3.7u; overall slope 4.4/3.7=1.189 >= 0.6 => auto hook-gate, the steep-staircase mechanic) -> flat top on the arch -> staircase back down -> rejoin. 5 steps over 3.7u => each 0.88u rise > 0.74u run (TALL grip-point edges). NON-HOOK leg => LOW route: dips UNDER the arch (a shallow underpass valley, lowDip 2.2) -> back up -> rejoin (UNCHANGED). Both routes REJOIN at the same x and base y; this is a BRANCH not a gate (no soft-lock — every leg progresses). Route is committed once at the fork mouth and ridden out (mid-fork redraw does NOT switch roads => no teleport). BOTH routes are always rendered (high arch + low underpass) so it reads as a split that merges.
STRAIGHT LEAD-IN to the curving road — the player runs straight here just before the sweeping S-bend, so the turn reads as a deliberate road shape (like the reference).
